attchmntText: Gulshan Polyols Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording of the Investor call held today, Friday, 13th November, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gulshan Polyols Limited submitted the audio recording of its investors call held on November 13, 2026, at 12:30 P.M. The submission was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The audio file is available on the company website at the link https://www.gulshanindia.com/audio-recording.html. The filing was addressed to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India. It was signed by Reetika Pant, Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Gulshan Polyols Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gulshan Polyols Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, the company reported income of Rs. 542 Cr, a 13% year-on-year increase, with profit after tax at Rs. 15.5 Cr and EBITDA at Rs. 42 Cr. For H1 FY27, income stood at Rs. 1,137 Cr, with PAT at Rs. 29 Cr and EBITDA at Rs. 81 Cr. The company maintains FY27 guidance of consolidated revenue at Rs. 2,600 Cr, targeting an EBITDA margin of 10-11% and a PAT margin of 5-6%. Strategic updates include a 19.7 crore litre order book for ESY 2026-27, capacity expansions in sorbitol and maltodextrin powder targeted for April 2027, and a partnership with Zero Footprint Industries Limited for a 6 MW green hydrogen plant.

attchmntText: Gulshan Polyols Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the outcome of the board meeting held on November 12, 2026 and the unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gulshan Polyols Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit after tax for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 3,888.99 Lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, net profit after tax stood at Rs. 9,239.53 Lakhs. Earnings per equity share were Rs. 6.24 for the quarter and Rs. 14.81 for the half year. Revenue from operations was Rs. 61,495.71 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 1,25,482.93 Lakhs for the half year. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s Shahid & Associates. The Board Meeting commenced at 04:00 P.M. and concluded at 05:15 P.M.

attchmntText: Gulshan Polyols Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the receipt of allocation for supply of Ethanol to OMCs (ESY 2026-27).
voiceSummary: Gulshan Polyols Limited has been allocated 1,96,886 Kiloliters of Ethanol for Ethanol Supply Year 2026-27 under CRFQ NO. 1000466894. The allocation is for supply to Oil Marketing Companies BPCL, HPCL, IOCL, and MRPL. The total quantity carries an aggregate value of approximately Rs. 1,304.90 Crores. The manufacturing process is expected to generate by-products contributing additional revenue of more than Rs. 300 crores. The Company anticipates aggregate revenue of more than Rs. 1,600 crores from this allocation and associated activities. This value is exclusive of freight and applicable taxes. The announcement was signed by Managing Director Aditi Pasari on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Gulshan Polyols Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Gulshan Polyols Limited will host an earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 12:30 P.M. IST. Pre-registration is available at https://tinyurl.com/2sb7msp2. Dial-in numbers are plus 91 22 6280 1527 and plus 91 22 7115 8322. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information will be disclosed during the meeting. The event will also be hosted on the company website at www.gulshanindia.com. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
